scope: Read all 24 passages, overviews, periods, endings and identity notes. Six selected root checks across 17 works.

sourcesChecked.checked: Direct EU statement dated 27 December 2025 confirms Israel's 26 December recognition and the EU's support for Somalia's sovereignty and territorial integrity.
Direct 27 November 2024 parliamentary answer confirms the 13 November vote and preliminary observers' largely credible, transparent and inclusive assessment.
Direct UNICEF 2022 story confirms Rahma's family chores, afternoon shifts for children tending livestock, and sorghum porridge, dates and milk.
Direct museum catalogue confirms Issa wooden vessel, circa 1930-1934, Rahale provenance, side handles and twisted fibre cord.
Direct 1943 official order, Articles 60-61 and 76-78, confirms camel rations, hospital pay deduction and equipment rules; copy presents these as regulations.
Direct French Senate historical report supports French Somali Coast and later Djibouti chronology; 1945 is not described as independence.

limits: Eleven other works were not independently reopened. Agent handoff records direct versus indexed access, including constitutional writing and colonial French order. This is bounded review, not full historical certification.
Somaliland sovereignty status is dated to the checked December 2025 EU statement; later status can change.
